item.title: Former Expedia employee gets 4 years in prison for Seattle bathroom spy camera case
item.description: A former Expedia employee was sentenced to four years in prison for a voyeurism scheme involving hidden bathroom cameras on the company’s Seattle campus.

item.title: Puyallup, WA protesters rally over ICE shooting, sheriff’s remarks
item.description: Protesters in Puyallup voiced anger over the fatal ICE shooting in Minneapolis, along with recent public statements from Pierce County Sheriff Keith Swank.

item.title: Here's why the Blue Angels in Seattle on Monday
item.description: The U.S. Navy Blue Angels were in Seattle on Monday to scout and plan for the 2026 Boeing Seafair Air Show.

item.title: Seattle weather: Dry start Saturday, increasing evening showers
item.description: It will be a dry start to the Saturday with mostly cloudy to partly cloudy skies. Highs will be several degrees warmer than average with gusty winds along the coast and north interior.

item.title: ICE protesters take to streets across WA over the weekend
item.description: Amid a national wave of protests, more residents across Washington continued to organize against recent actions by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: Seahawks receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba named AP first-team All-Pro, 4 named to second-team
item.description: Seattle Seahawks receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba has been named AP first-team All-Pro. Four more Seahawks players were named to the second-team.

item.title: Soggy weather again in Seattle by Sunday
item.description: After a mostly cloudy and dry start to the day, increasing rain is forecast in Western Washington between tonight and Monday.

item.title: 2 men killed, 2 rescued from avalanche in Kittitas County, WA
item.description: Two people are dead, and another two were rescued, after an avalanche hit in an area near Longs Pass in northern Kittitas County.

item.title: Crowd protests in Lynnwood and across WA after ICE kills Minneapolis woman
item.description: “I’m 89 years old and I’ve never seen anything like this in our country," one protester in Lynnwood told FOX 13 today. We talk to residents about ICE controversies.

item.title: Hurricanes score twice in third period as Seattle Kraken lose 3-2
item.description: Jaccob Slavin's first assist of the season on William Carrier's goal lifted the Carolina Hurricanes to a 3-2 win over the Seattle Kraken on Saturday night.
